title: Class A taxonomy node
description: One node of the GPCRdb Class A hierarchy: the class root, a major family or a receptor family. Source identifiers and project identifiers are kept in separate fields so a project-generated id can never be mistaken for an upstream one.

source_id.description: Identifier as issued by the source (GPCRdb family slug).

project_slug.description: Project-generated. The 'ca-' prefix marks it as ours.
